text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automated page fired: service=inference-prod(us-east-1) metric=p99_latency threshold=3.0s current=3.8s. PagerDuty INC-2026-412 created. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/inference/p99?from=now-15m

michael: acked. i'm on it. @pagerduty who got escalated? :hand:

priya: looks localized to us-east-1. p95 ~1.1s, p99 spike to 3.8s. Node groups gpu-pool-7..9 showing kernel stalls and elevated GPU utilization. KV cache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 60% around the same window.

michael: ok. first things: (1) can we warm kvcache on affected pods? (2) check autoscaler events and quota errors. i'll also reduce concurrency for noisy tenants temporarily.

jen: autoscaler logs show scale-up triggered at 1715554380 but failed due to quota limit: "insufficient accelerators" in cloud events. raising infra ticket now.

pagerduty: Escalation: on-call eng-sre (john) and eng-runtime team notified.

michael: applying temporary ingress throttle on heavy routes to preserve capacity. command: `kubectl patch config ingress --patch '{"spec":{"maxConcurrency":8}}' -n inference`

priya: applying kv warmup job to pods in gpu-pool-7..9 now (small warm requests to populate prefix cache). queue length drops immediately on those nodes; p95 -> 0.9s but p99 still ~2.9s.

michael: enabling fallback model variant (quantized q4_8) for long-gen requests on this pool at 10% traffic. will monitor quality regressions.

jen: fallback rollout at 10% applied via canary. instant effect: p99 -> 2.1s. logs show fewer OOM / kernel timeouts.

sam-oncall: infra replied to quota ticket: can approve temporary burst of 8 GPUs to the project, ETA ~25m. requesting approval now.

michael: thanks. customer impact: some customers may experience slower long generations or truncated fallback results, no data loss. notif to support: "Inc INC-2026-412: p99 latency spike in us-east. Mitigations in flight (throttle + kv-warm + fallback). ETA to stable ~30m."

priya: posted dashboard snapshot here: https://grafana.redwood/snapshot/abcd1234 (shows p95/p99 and kv-hit %).

michael: plan: continue monitoring, keep throttle and fallback until quota bump comes up and new nodes join. if p99 < 1.5s for 10m, we'll start rolling back throttle gradually. handoff in 30m to @sam-oncall.

sam-oncall: ack — i'll take rotation at 1715554700 and watch the dash + PD alerts. i'll coordinate with infra for quota and with eng-runtime for warming if needed.

incident-bot: INC-2026-412 status updated -> mitigated (monitoring). page closed :white_check_mark:

michael: thanks team. quick postmortem draft later: root suspects = GPU quota pressure + KV cache cold/shifts from traffic pattern. we'll add warmup + autoscaler guard rails.

sam-oncall: copying notes into incident doc and pinging support for customer bulletin. :eyes:
